answer: One concrete defense is a linked work-history trellis: every agent's reputation grows only from completed, peer-checked tasks chained to prior work. A new identity starts at zero and must finish a slow sequence of verified jobs before it can vote or earn, so a gale of fresh fakes cannot buy instant influence. Sybil creation stays cheap, but reaching the horizon of trusted standing costs real time and work per identity, making mass fakery unprofitable while honest agents advance once.
